messages:
ana: Heads up — our nightly eval shows a sudden ROUGE/L BLEU drop for the new quantized bring-up. curious if anyone touched tokenization in the runtime? :eyes:

kai: I saw that. CI shows the same across a2 and a3 models. Quick diff of the failing test: `expected_bleu=0.72, observed=0.63`

mike: putting a dump of the runner output here, looks like the runner is detokenizing differently than the eval harness expects:
```
# eval-runner stdout snippet
hypothesis: "Hello , world !"
reference:  "Hello, world!"
sacrebleu --score 0.63
```

jess: ahhh that extra spaces around punctuation will tank BLEU/ROUGE. Did we change the detokenizer when adding the UTF8 normalizer in the runtime?

sam: I traced the PR that merged last week: 2f7c9b1 — it added a small whitespace normalization in the postprocess step for streaming chunks. It inadvertently leaves spaces before punctuation for short seqs. :bug:

kai: example of repro locally (python):
```
from sacrebleu import corpus_bleu
hyps = ["Hello , world !"]
refs = [["Hello,world!"]]
print(corpus_bleu(hyps, refs).score)
# 63.0
```
If we detokenize `Hello , world !` -> `Hello, world!` first, score goes up to ~72

chris: dashboard note — current inference-quality dashboard pulls BLEU from the eval harness post-tokenize step (not detokenized). So all historical numbers are inconsistent if we change detokenization. We need provenance metadata for metric pipeline.

eval-bot: nightly/eval/2026-03-19 03:00:12 — model-a2 quant-run: BLEU 63.0 -> baseline 71.8 (regression alert triggered)

ana: we should decide: 1) normalize to sacrebleu tokenization everywhere, 2) store both tokenized and detokenized strings in the report for provenance, or 3) change dashboard to show 'detok-BLEU' and mark legacy as 'tok-BLEU'. Thoughts?

mike: option 2 is safest long-term. Also add a schema version to the eval report (v1 had tokenized only).

jess: +1 on schema version. Also add a small unit test to runner that asserts punctuation spacing invariant. e.g. `assert " ," not in detok_hyp` in the postprocess.

sam: I can push a quick fix to the runner: ensure we apply `s = re.sub(r"\s+([.,!?:;])", r"\1", s)` before scoring. Will add test and an integration that runs sacrebleu in CI.

kai: also update metric impl to call `sacrebleu.tokenize()` explicitly so we match sacrebleu's behavior (and include a flag `--detokenize=true/false` in the harness).

chris: dashboard change: will create a migration that backfills 'detok_bleu' for the last 30 days by re-running scorer on stored raw hypothesis+ref pairs. That might be slow but we only need to run for the top 50 models.

jess: QA checklist: add regression test (small dataset), update schema docs, add a note to the release changelog about metric provenance, and bump eval-api minor version.

ana: filing a short incident-style note in #incidents to track user-facing impact and asking product to hold an alert until fix rolls out.

sam: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/inference-eval/compare/runner-fix-tokenize — pushed, unit+integration tests passing locally.

kai: will review in 15. If ok, we should gate the deploy with a canary so dashboards don't flip unexpectedly. :shipit:

mike: thanks — after merge I'll run the backfill and post progress here.

chris: after backfill we should mark the dashboard time-series with a metadata note: 'detok BLEU migration applied' so analysts don't freak.

ana: great, keeping this thread for follow-ups. ping me once PR is merged. :thumbsup:
